crossRefs.keyword: recall to my mind. Heb. make to return to my heart

crossRefs.note: “Yahweh is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”
My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.
Israel, hope in Yahweh, for there is loving kindness with Yahweh. Abundant redemption is with him.
For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes…

translations.bsb: Yet I call this to mind, and therefore I have hope:
translations.kjv: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.
